edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Comm. Cant. Liber I 15

source_text: Aequitas dilexit te. Adulescentulae velut satisfacientes dicunt hoc, quasi nondum perfecte diligant ubera super vinum. Aequitas est quae diligit Christum, quia caritas nihil iniquitatis admittit. Si diligitis me, mandata mea servate: qui diligit, custodit; qui custodit, aequitatem habet. Quantum iniquitatis in nobis est, tantum longe sumus a dilectione Christi.
pass_a_gloss: Equity loved you. Young-women as-if making-satisfaction say this, as-if not-yet perfectly they-love breasts above wine. Equity is which loves Christ, because charity nothing of-iniquity admits...
pass_b_english: [[Equity has loved you >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:4]]. The young women say this as if making excuse, as though they do not yet perfectly love the breasts above wine. Equity is what loves Christ, because charity admits no iniquity. [[If you love me, keep my commandments >> Bible:John 14:15]]: whoever loves, keeps; whoever keeps, has equity. As much iniquity as is in us, so far are we from the love of Christ.
